Package org.geysermc.paletter.behaviour

Class ItemBehaviour

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.behaviour.ItemBehaviour
public final class ItemBehaviour extends Object
The behaviour keys of item types, read with palette.resolve(variant).behaviour().get(key) (ItemValues). Values are per item type (not per aux value) and per data version. Each key is a property of Bedrock Dedicated Server (its source is named on the key).
Since:
0.1.0

    • USE_DURATION

      public static final IntKey USE_DURATION
      Ticks of using the item (eating, drinking, ...). Known for component based items (from what BDS sends); null for items whose use is native code (bow, trident, potion) until the native capture exists.

      BDS: Item.mMaxUseDuration (native; from third-party dumps until Paletter captures it).

      Custom items set it with minecraft:use_modifiers.

    • USE_ANIMATION

      public static final IntKey USE_ANIMATION
      The use animation id BDS sends (item_properties.use_animation: 1 eat, 2 drink, 6 spear, ...).

      BDS: Item.mUseAnim (native; from third-party dumps until Paletter captures it).

      Custom items set it with minecraft:use_animation.
